realmlord.bag.no_territory: A Resources Bag empties into a territory's stores. Found your village first.
realmlord.bag.opened: %s Resources Bag emptied: %s food, %s wood, %s stone and %s iron ore added to the stores of %s.
realmlord.bag.tooltip: Holds %s food, %s wood, %s stone and %s iron ore.
realmlord.bag.tooltip.use: Use to empty it into your territory's stores.
realmlord.blueprint.tooltip.keep: Needed to construct it. Construction arrives in Phase 2; keep it safe.
realmlord.build.demolishing: Your builders will take down the %s and carry its materials back to the stores.
realmlord.build.err.blueprint: You need its blueprint (bandits drop them, or buy one at the market).
realmlord.build.err.border: It must stand inside your territory's border.
realmlord.build.err.fence_exists: The fence is already built or under construction.
realmlord.build.err.grade: Your village is not yet of the grade to build this.
realmlord.build.err.manor: Leave the Lord's Manor yard clear.
realmlord.build.err.not_placed: That building is not placed by hand.
realmlord.build.err.resources: Not enough wood or stone in the stores.
realmlord.build.err.slope: The ground is too steep there.
realmlord.build.err.specialist: You need a resident with the right trade to build this.
realmlord.build.err.water: Too deep. Settlers fill in ponds, marsh and shallow water up to 3 blocks deep, but not this.
realmlord.build.staffed: %s has started work at the new %s.
realmlord.build.started: Construction of the %s has begun. It takes %s hours with five builders; you have %s.
realmlord.building.ancestral_hall.desc: Where residents honour their ancestors. Raises culture and People's Thoughts.
realmlord.building.bathroom.desc: Improves sanitation and health. Lifts People's Thoughts.
realmlord.building.blacksmith_workshop.d: Makes farm tools such as axes and chisels. Needs a junior blacksmith. A blacksmith working here sells iron tools and weapons.
realmlord.building.clinic.desc: Medical treatment for the villagers. Needs a doctor.
realmlord.building.dining_hall.desc: Where residents eat together. Lifts People's Thoughts; a cook can work here.
realmlord.building.farmland.desc: 10 mu of fields, 200 food per mu each harvest. Sow at Qingming (month 4) or early July (month 7); harvest three months later. Five farmers work it.
realmlord.building.granary.desc: Storage for the harvest. Raises the economy.
realmlord.building.grocery_shop.desc: Sells daily necessities. Needs a grocer, who then sells torches, candles and goods.
realmlord.building.logging_field.desc: Speeds up timber: 10 wood per worker per day. Holds 10 workers.
realmlord.building.martial_arts_dojo.des: A training hall for martial arts. Needs a martial artist.
realmlord.building.military_camp.desc: The basic barracks, where farmers become militia (Phase 2b). Needs an officer.
realmlord.building.mining_field.desc: Speeds up iron ore: 2 ore per worker per day. Holds 10 workers.
realmlord.building.private_school.desc: Teaches the village's children. Needs a scholar. Raises culture.
realmlord.building.quarry.desc: Speeds up stone: 5 stone per worker per day. Holds 10 workers.
realmlord.building.sentry_post.desc: Warns the territory when enemies approach. +5 Security.
realmlord.building.simple_fence.desc: A weak fortification that keeps out wild animals. Rings the whole territory border: each post is an oak plank set in the ground, two fence blocks and a plank rail on top. You choose where the gates go. +10 Security.
realmlord.building.small_residential_cou: A walled courtyard in the old style: a hall across the back and a wing down each side around a yard. Straw beds for 20 residents (23 in all), who sleep here at night.
realmlord.building.stable.desc: Keeps horses. A stableman working here sells saddles and leads.
realmlord.building.stone_outpost.desc: A sturdy stone outpost with an early-warning post. +5 Security.
realmlord.building.tailor_workshop.desc: Sews clothing. Needs a tailor, who then sells clothing and cloth.
realmlord.building.temple.desc: A place of worship. Lifts People's Thoughts and culture.
realmlord.building.weapons_workshop.desc: Makes weapons and armour. Needs an advanced blacksmith.
realmlord.camp.choose: What becomes of the bandit camp? %s  %s
realmlord.camp.keep_tip: Leave the tents, pen and campfire standing where they are.
realmlord.camp.not_now: There is no cleared bandit camp waiting for your decision.
realmlord.camp.salvage_tip: Take the whole camp apart: every pole, cloth, bar, log, barrel and the campfire comes back to you as materials, with anything left inside, and the ground grows over.
realmlord.camp.salvaged: You take the bandit camp apart and carry off %s items of materials. Nothing of it remains.
realmlord.class.bailiff.desc: A constable who hunts down outlaws and drags them to justice. Skills: Iron Shackles, Arrest, Patrol Sense.
realmlord.class.chivalrous_expert.desc: A wandering swordsman of the martial world, swift and deadly alone. Skills: Swift Sword, Lightness Skill, Hundred Strikes.
realmlord.class.general.desc: A commander who leads from the front. Skills: War Cry, Cavalry Charge, Unyielding Will.
realmlord.class.healer.desc: A physician of the battlefield who mends allies and pins foes with needles. Skills: Rejuvenate, Acupuncture Needle, Purify.
realmlord.class.priest.desc: A Taoist priest versed in the classics, talismans and elixirs, who later presides over temples. Skills: Thunder Talisman, Golden Elixir, Exorcism Seal.
realmlord.class.strategist.desc: A master of stratagems who wins battles before they begin. Skills: Fire Stratagem, Confusion Array, Battle Insight.
realmlord.cmd.capitals_note: The novel's nine Imperial Capitals, where they stand in an Earth Online: China world. Luoyang is the centre of the world.
realmlord.cmd.info.head: %s: %s (%s), level %s, %s, %s merit
realmlord.cmd.info.innate: Body Structure %s, Comprehension %s, Luck %s, Charm %s, reputation %s
realmlord.cmd.info.none: %s has not chosen a path yet.
realmlord.cmd.info.stats: Command %s, Force %s, Intelligence %s, Politics %s, %s points unspent
realmlord.cmd.reset: Reset %s. They will choose their path again.
realmlord.cmd.territories.none: No villages have been founded yet.
realmlord.coin.break: Use: break one coin into 100 of the coin below
realmlord.coin.combine: Sneak + use: change 100 coins into one of the coin above
realmlord.coin.need: You need %s %s to change them up.
realmlord.found.not_lord: Only a Lord can found a village.
realmlord.found.overworld: Villages can only be founded in the main world.
realmlord.found.too_close: Too close to another territory. Move at least %s blocks further away.
realmlord.found.world: Congratulations to %s for founding village no. %s in the world: %s, of %s grade! Special reward: %s merit.
realmlord.hud.quest_camp: Find the bandit camp near X %s, Z %s
realmlord.hud.quest_found: Use your token to found your village
realmlord.innate.body.desc: Body Structure: toughness and survival, adapting to the environment, and storing Qi. Raises your maximum health.
realmlord.innate.charm.desc: Charm: first impressions with NPCs and how easily sudden encounters go your way. Matters once you deal with talents and merchants.
realmlord.innate.comprehension.desc: Comprehension: how quickly and deeply you learn. Raises all experience you earn by 1% per point above 5.
realmlord.innate.luck.desc: Luck: unexpected windfalls and losses. Feeds the game's luck, for better fishing and loot.
realmlord.job.err.admin: Only civil servants and scholars can do administration.
realmlord.job.err.full: No free places for that job. Build more of its fields.
realmlord.job.err.wrong_trade: That workplace needs a different trade.
realmlord.ledger.cipher: The pages are in a bandit cipher that means nothing to you.
realmlord.ledger.done: You have already dug up the chief's treasure.
realmlord.ledger.read: The ledger's last page, in a crude hand: "The chief's share lies buried under the fire." (near X %s, Z %s)
realmlord.ledger.tooltip: Taken from a Bandit Chief. Use to read.
realmlord.manor.cancel.tip: Stop building. Three quarters of the wood and stone not yet used come back now; builders take down what stands and carry back three quarters of what it used.
realmlord.manor.crew.tip: Builders on this site. + and - set the number yourself (gold), taking on idle residents if needed; going below zero returns the site to sharing the free builders (grey). Every builder adds work, with no limit.
realmlord.manor.max_level: Your territory is at its highest level.
realmlord.manor.people_hint: The best-suited idle residents take a job first. Open a talent's card to set their job or workplace yourself.
realmlord.manor.title: Lord's Manor
realmlord.manor.unclaimed: This seal belongs to no territory.
realmlord.map.demolish.tip: Builders take it down from the top and carry three quarters of its wood and stone back to the stores, as planks and cobblestone.
realmlord.map.fence.hint: Click the ring to add a gate there, or click a gate (gold) to remove it. Each gateway is three posts wide.
realmlord.map.place_hint: Click the map to place it here. Right-click turns it; the yellow edge is the door. Green fits, red does not. Builders will clear and level the ground first.
realmlord.map.salvage: Taking it down returns about %s wood and %s stone.
realmlord.map.title: Territory Map
realmlord.map.view_hint: Click a building to select it; you can then demolish it. Ground you have not loaded nearby shows dark. Choose Place in the Construction tab to put a building down from here.
realmlord.market.goods_note: Green goods come from your workshops (daily change in colour). Storehouse: %s stacks.
realmlord.market.not_enough: Your stores do not hold that much.
realmlord.market.nothing_special: You carry nothing the Special Items platform buys.
realmlord.market.platform.locked: Not open yet. As in the novel, the Limited Time Auction and the Negotiation Cooperation platforms open as the market grows (town level).
realmlord.market.sell_all.tip: Sell the whole stock, less the 20% tax.
realmlord.market.sell_special: Sell gear and blueprints in your pack
realmlord.market.sell_special.tip: Graded weapons and armour (Bronze 20 silver, Black Iron 1 gold, Silver 5 gold, Gold 20 gold) and building blueprints (half their price), less the 20% tax.
realmlord.market.sold_special: The market bought your special items for %s.
realmlord.market.special_note: The Special Items Trading Platform deals in rare things: graded equipment and building blueprints. Sell what you carry, or buy the blueprints your village can build below.
realmlord.market.tax_note: Buys go into your stores and sales come out of them. Sales pay a 20%% transaction tax.
realmlord.market.title: Basic Market
realmlord.msg.chose_adventurer: You have chosen the path of an Adventurer, as a %s. The world is yours to roam.
realmlord.msg.chose_lord: You have chosen the path of a Lord, with %s as your sub-profession. The Village Creation quest has begun.
realmlord.msg.level_up: You reached level %s. Unspent attribute points: %s (press J).
realmlord.msg.title: Your merit has earned you the title %s.
realmlord.msg.welcome: Welcome to the world. Choose your path: rule as a Lord or roam as an Adventurer. (Press J if the window closed.)
realmlord.msg.work_up: Your %s rose to level %s (%s). Unspent attribute points: %s.
realmlord.occupation.blacksmith.eval: Forges tools and weapons, given a forge.
realmlord.occupation.carpenter.eval: Good with timber; fast at logging and building.
realmlord.occupation.civil_servant.eval: Handles administration; raises the political index when given work.
realmlord.occupation.cook.eval: Feeds the village from the dining hall.
realmlord.occupation.doctor.eval: Treats the sick; runs a clinic.
realmlord.occupation.farmer.eval: A plain, hard-working farmer who knows the soil.
realmlord.occupation.fisherman.eval: Fishes the rivers and the sea.
realmlord.occupation.fruit_farmer.eval: Tends orchards and knows every tree by its fruit.
realmlord.occupation.grocer.eval: Keeps a shop of daily necessities.
realmlord.occupation.hunter.eval: Lives off the forest; handy at logging.
realmlord.occupation.martial_artist.eval: Skilled in the martial arts; can run a dojo.
realmlord.occupation.mason.eval: Cuts and lays stone; fast at quarrying and building.
realmlord.occupation.miner.eval: Knows where ore lies; fast at mining.
realmlord.occupation.officer.eval: A minor officer, needed to run a military camp.
realmlord.occupation.scholar.eval: Learned in the classics; can teach or help administer.
realmlord.panel.no_skills: Trades have no combat skills. Their bonuses work on their own as you practise.
realmlord.panel.quest.adventurer: Only Lords take the Village Creation quest. Adventurers are free to roam.
realmlord.panel.quest.claimed: Complete. You earned a %s Village Creation Token.
realmlord.panel.quest.failed: You failed the Village Creation quest and lost the right to found a village.
realmlord.panel.quest.name: Village Creation Quest
realmlord.panel.quest.obj_bandits: Free the settlers from the bandit camp near X %s, Z %s (%s bandits left)
realmlord.panel.quest.obj_bandits_hidden: Free the settlers from the bandits
realmlord.panel.quest.obj_treasure: Optional: find the Bandit Chief's buried treasure
realmlord.panel.quest.ready: The settlers are free. Claim your reward.
realmlord.panel.territory.coming: Right-click the Lord's Manor Seal to run your village: build, assign people, trade at the market and upgrade.
realmlord.panel.territory.none_lord: You have no territory yet. Complete the Village Creation quest, then use your Village Creation Token on the ground where your village should stand. The first villages in the world earn the most merit.
realmlord.panel.territory.order: Founded: village no. %s in the world
realmlord.panel.territory.req_index: Politics, economy, culture and military indexes of %s
realmlord.panel.territory.world: Villages in the world: %s · Gold token: %s
realmlord.panel.title: Character
realmlord.place.hint: Right-click: place · Sneak + right-click: turn · Left-click: cancel
realmlord.quest.bandits: The supplies are ready, but bandits have seized the settlers! Their camp lies near X %s, Z %s, to the %s, about %s blocks away. Drive them out.
realmlord.quest.cache: You found the Bandit Chief's buried treasure.
realmlord.quest.camp_found: You have found the bandit camp. Defeat every bandit and their chief.
realmlord.quest.chief_down: The Bandit Chief has fallen. He dropped a ledger.
realmlord.quest.claimed: Village Creation quest complete! You received the village creation set: a %s Village Creation Token, a Summoning Token (%s) and a %s Resources Bag. Use the token on the ground where your village should stand.
realmlord.quest.cleared: The camp is cleared and %s captive families go free: %s people will follow you. They wait by the camp until you found your village. Open the Quest tab (J) to claim your reward.
realmlord.quest.failed_abandon: You abandoned the Village Creation quest.
realmlord.quest.failed_now_adventurer: Without settlers you cannot found a village. You continue as an Adventurer.
realmlord.quest.failed_time: You ran out of time. The settlers have scattered.
realmlord.quest.gold_world: %s has earned the only Gold Village Creation Token in the world!
realmlord.quest.nothing: You carry nothing the settlers need. Supplies so far: logs %s/%s, stone %s/%s, food %s/%s.
realmlord.quest.start: Village Creation quest: settlers are waiting for a lord to lead them. First gather supplies for them: %s logs, %s stone and %s food, then hand them over in the Quest tab of your panel (J). You have %s days. Finish within %s days for a Gold token; the slower you are, the lower the grade. The bandits are strong: get yourself iron armour first.
realmlord.quest.warning: Less than a day remains to finish the Village Creation quest.
realmlord.resident.name: Name: %s (%s)
realmlord.resident.no_workplace: No finished workplace needs a %s yet.
realmlord.resident.skill_hint: Their trade, rank and specialty make them %s%% better at their current work.
realmlord.resident.title: Resident
realmlord.restriction.sent_home: You have been returned to your territory.
realmlord.restriction.warning: A Lord may not leave their territory outside of war. Return within %s seconds or be sent home.
realmlord.role.adventurer_desc: Roam the world freely. Choose a combat occupation with levels and skills, or a trade that grows from Junior to Master. Adventurers learn a quarter faster, and their strength is entirely their own. Every character rolls innate Body Structure, Comprehension, Luck and Charm.
realmlord.role.combat_desc: Combat occupations have a character level (up to 100) and three skills each, learned at levels 1, 10 and 25. Each level gives 2 attribute points and every fifth level raises all four by 1. Experience is lost on death.
realmlord.role.lord_desc: Rule a territory. Earn a Village Creation Token through a demanding quest, found your village and raise it, grade by grade, into a town, county, prefecture and beyond. Merit raises your noble title, which every upgrade requires. You also pick a sub-profession.
realmlord.role.lord_restricted: On this world, Lords may not leave their territory except for war.
realmlord.role.subtitle: This choice cannot be undone.
realmlord.role.title: Choose Your Path
realmlord.role.work_desc: Work occupations have no character level, only a craft level from 1 to 10 (Junior, Intermediate, Advanced, Master). They never lose experience on death. A Lord with a trade still has a character level.
realmlord.skill.acupuncture_needle.desc: A needle to the pressure points pins your target in place.
realmlord.skill.arrest.desc: Haul your target to your feet.
realmlord.skill.battle_insight.desc: Every foe within 32 blocks glows, and your mind and eyes sharpen.
realmlord.skill.cavalry_charge.desc: Charge forward, striking and scattering the foes in your path.
realmlord.skill.confusion_array.desc: Foes near your target lose their quarry and are slowed and weakened.
realmlord.skill.exorcism_seal.desc: Seal the area you look at, harming and weakening every foe there. Undead suffer double.
realmlord.skill.fire_stratagem.desc: Set the spot you look at ablaze, burning and harming every foe there.
realmlord.skill.golden_elixir.desc: Share an elixir: you and nearby allies regenerate, resist fire and toughen.
realmlord.skill.hundred_strikes.desc: A storm of blows on every foe within reach.
realmlord.skill.iron_shackles.desc: Bind your target so it can barely move.
realmlord.skill.lightness_skill.desc: Move like the wind: speed, high leaps and a feather's fall.
realmlord.skill.none: You have no skill to use.
realmlord.skill.patrol_sense.desc: Every foe within 48 blocks is revealed, and you quicken your step.
realmlord.skill.purify.desc: Cleanse harmful effects and fire from yourself and nearby allies.
realmlord.skill.swift_sword.desc: Dash and cut through the enemies ahead.
realmlord.skill.thunder_talisman.desc: Burn a talisman to call thunder down on your target, harming and slowing it.
realmlord.skill.unyielding_will.desc: Steel yourself with heavy Absorption and Resistance.
realmlord.skill.war_cry.desc: You and nearby allies gain Strength and Resistance; nearby foes are weakened.
realmlord.spawn.arrived: You arrive at %s, %s. This is now where you wake.
realmlord.spawn.biome.coast.desc: A beach by the sea, with fish and open views.
realmlord.spawn.biome.forest.desc: Woodland with plenty of timber, and clearings to build in.
realmlord.spawn.biome.hills.desc: Hills and blossom groves, with stone close at hand.
realmlord.spawn.biome.jungle.desc: Hot, wet jungle, thick with growth.
realmlord.spawn.biome.plains.desc: Flat, open grassland: the easiest ground for a village to grow on.
realmlord.spawn.biome.river.desc: Beside a river: water, fertile banks and easy travel.
realmlord.spawn.biome.savanna.desc: Dry, warm grassland with scattered trees.
realmlord.spawn.biome.taiga.desc: Cool spruce forest: hard country, but rich in wood.
realmlord.spawn.china.central_plains.des: The heart of the land on the Yellow River: wide, flat, fertile farmland that is easy to build on. Open on every side, so easy to reach and hard to defend.
realmlord.spawn.china.fujian.desc: A hilly southern coast of harbours and green hills. Warm and out of the way.
realmlord.spawn.china.guanzhong.desc: The Wei River valley, ringed by mountains and guarded by passes. Fertile and easy to defend; many dynasties rose here.
realmlord.spawn.china.jiangnan.desc: The Yangtze delta: rivers, lakes and warm, wet country. Rich in food and close to the sea.
realmlord.spawn.china.jingxiang.desc: A crossroads on the Han River between north and south. Good land, but every army passes through.
realmlord.spawn.china.shanhai.desc: Where Ouyang Shuo founded Shanhai Village in the novel: a warm, fertile basin in the far south, ringed by mountains and opening onto the sea. Far from the great powers, with room to grow.
realmlord.spawn.china.sichuan.desc: The Land of Abundance: rich farmland walled in by mountains on every side. Safe and wealthy, but far from everywhere.
realmlord.spawn.china.youyan.desc: The northern frontier beyond the plains: cooler country near the mountains, with room to grow.
realmlord.spawn.china.yunnan.desc: Highland lakes and mountains in the far south-west. Remote, mild and beautiful.
realmlord.spawn.custom.desc: Anywhere on land. You will arrive on the nearest dry ground.
realmlord.spawn.err.far: That place is out of reach.
realmlord.spawn.err.placed: You have already chosen where to begin.
realmlord.spawn.err.sea: That is open water. Choose somewhere on land.
realmlord.spawn.hint: Scroll to zoom and drag to move the map. Click a red marker or anywhere on land, then press Begin here.
realmlord.spawn.title: Where Will You Begin?
realmlord.specialty.capable_administrato: Raises the political index more in administration.
realmlord.specialty.ore_seeker.desc: Digs more ore in the mining field.
realmlord.specialty.stonecutter.desc: Cuts more stone in the quarry.
realmlord.specialty.timber_sense.desc: Cuts more wood in the logging field.
realmlord.stat.command.desc: Command: how strong your troops are on the battlefield, how many you can lead, how easily you recruit and how quickly they respond. Now: your animals hit harder.
realmlord.stat.force.desc: Force: the power of special attacks and the chance of critical hits (0.25% per point, for half again the damage). Also adds to melee damage and strengthens physical skills.
realmlord.stat.intelligence.desc: Intelligence: lengthens buffs and controls, shortens skill cooldowns, widens your troops' vision and speeds weapon development.
realmlord.stat.politics.desc: Politics: how well your policies work on markets and farms, and how diplomacy goes. Matters once your territory grows.
realmlord.storage.hand_in.tip: Puts every log, plank, stone, iron ore, grain, meat, fish, leather and other trade good you carry into the village's stores, where builders and workshops use them and the market can sell them.
realmlord.storage.handed_in: %s items handed in to the village stores.
realmlord.storage.open.tip: The Lord's Manor storehouse: 54 slots to keep anything for later (salvaged materials, tools, loot). Kept with your territory.
realmlord.storage.sell.tip: Sells every trade good in the storehouse at market prices, less the 20% tax. Other items stay.
realmlord.storage.title: %s Storehouse
realmlord.summoning.not_yet: No talent answers the call yet. Keep the Summoning Token: it will work once historical figures arrive (Phase 3).
realmlord.summoning.tooltip: Summons a random %s historical figure to serve you.
realmlord.summoning.tooltip2: Talents arrive in Phase 3. Keep this token until then.
realmlord.token.tooltip.black_iron: Earned by finishing the quest within 7.5 days.
realmlord.token.tooltip.bronze: The most common token. Most villages begin this way.
realmlord.token.tooltip.gold: Earned by finishing within 3 days. There is only one in all the world.
realmlord.token.tooltip.name: Rename it in an anvil to name your village.
realmlord.token.tooltip.silver: Earned by finishing the quest within 5 days.
realmlord.token.tooltip.use: Use on the ground to found your village there.
realmlord.trade.need_items: You do not have enough to sell.
realmlord.trade.no_workshop: Needs a workshop to work in first.
realmlord.upgrade.done: %s is now a %s of grade %s! The Lord's Manor grows with it. Choose one of three buildings to receive for free.
realmlord.upgrade.free_chosen: You will receive a %s for free. Place it from the Construction tab.
realmlord.upgrade.need_index: All four indexes at %s or more
realmlord.upgrade.town_later: Upgrading to a town arrives in Phase 4
realmlord.upgrade.world: %s has made the world's no. %s %s of grade %s! Reward: %s merit.
realmlord.village.hungry: %s has run out of food! People's Thoughts are falling and residents will leave.
realmlord.work.architect.desc: Learns by building. Reach grows with rank, and the Architect will matter for construction in your territory.
realmlord.work.blacksmith.desc: Learns by forging metal weapons, tools and armour, and smelting ingots. From Intermediate rank on, gear you forge comes out with Unbreaking.
realmlord.work.breeder.desc: Learns by breeding animals. Higher ranks are blessed with twins more and more often.
realmlord.work.carpenter.desc: Learns by felling trees and making wooden goods. You chop wood faster.
realmlord.work.cook.desc: Learns by cooking and preparing food. Meals fill you more.
realmlord.work.farmer.desc: Learns by tilling and harvesting ripe crops. Higher ranks reap extra harvest.
realmlord.work.fisherman.desc: Learns by fishing. Higher ranks often pull up a second catch.
realmlord.work.mason.desc: Learns by quarrying and dressing stone. You cut stone faster.
realmlord.work.physician.desc: Learns by brewing potions. All healing you receive is stronger, and higher ranks sometimes brew a bonus potion.
realmlord.work.shipbuilder.desc: Learns by building boats. You swim faster and waste less timber.
realmlord.work.tailor.desc: Learns by making leather armour, wool, carpets, beds and banners. From Intermediate rank on, leather armour you sew carries Protection.
realmlord.work.veterinarian.desc: Learns by feeding, breeding and taming animals. Animals you feed recover, and your own animals take less damage.
realmlord.work.winemaker.desc: Learns by brewing and preparing sugar and honey. Potions you drink last longer.
realmlord.worldmap.title: World Map
